about: Renders a short label beside a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus.

placement.about: The content on each side of the trigger, set by the machine's `positioning.placement`. The machine flips content that would cross the edge of the window to the opposite side.
placement.title: Placement

title: Tooltip

variant.about: Both looks at every size. A tooltip opens after `openDelay` when the pointer rests on its trigger, and at once when keyboard focus moves to the trigger.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
